messages.author: b0084e74319ebcb3
messages.subject: NaNs on distsamp
parts:
Good morning to all,

I am fitting models with several (4 total) categorical and continuous site covariates using distsamp. I am fitting models using different combinations of these variables, and everything is working except that in two cases I am getting a warning message "NaNs have been produce". I can see that I get estimates for most of parameters, but I am not sure if I can trust in these given the warning (for example, the AIC). Should I worry? How can I fix this? Thanks in advance!

Best,

Laura

messages.author: 4a635fe980c8c1cd
messages.subject: Re: NaNs on distsamp
parts:
Hi Laura,

I think that if you search for this warning within the group, you should find several threads concerning this topic.  If the warning refers to the variance covariance matrix (and parameter SE's), then the estimates and the likelihood itself are not valid.  You could try to increase the number of optimizing iterations, simplify the model, etc.

Cheers,

Johnh
